why: Akio Kawauchi has a series of arXiv papers (e.g. 2303.04368, revised April 2024, and related 2212.02617, 2303.13728) claiming a full proof of the Whitehead aspherical conjecture via ribbon sphere-link methods, published in a low-profile journal; no corroboration found that this is accepted by the topology community, and the conjecture's own Wikipedia article still presents it as open with no update reflecting a resolution.
queries: Kawauchi Whitehead conjecture ribbon sphere-link proof status withdrawn

found.title: Whitehead aspherical conjecture via ribbon sphere-link
found.note: Preprint (v2, revised April 2024) by Kawauchi claiming a full proof of the conjecture; not read, no independent verification found.
